note: Series group names are taken from the USAJOBS Help Center page "How to filter results by series". Descriptions are adapted for consistency in length, voice, and clarity.

intro.professional: Professional occupations are positions whose primary duty requires knowledge or experience of an administrative, clerical, scientific, artistic, or technical nature and is not related to trade, craft, or manual labor work.
intro.tradeCraftLabor: Trade, craft or labor positions involve the performance of physical work and require knowledge or experience of a trade, craft, or manual labor nature.

series.name: Miscellaneous Occupations
series.description: Covers positions focused on work that does not fit other occupational groups because the duties are unique or combine multiple fields.

series.name: Social Science, Psychology, and Welfare
series.description: Covers positions focused on social science, psychology, social work, recreation, and public welfare or insurance programs.

series.name: Human Resources Management
series.description: Covers positions focused on recruiting, staffing, employee relations, benefits, and other major areas of human resources management.

series.name: General Administrative, Clerical, and Office Services
series.description: Covers positions focused on general administrative, clerical, secretarial, office support, records, and communications work.

series.name: Natural Resources Management and Biological Sciences
series.description: Covers positions focused on biological sciences, natural resources, soil, conservation, and related environmental management.

series.name: Accounting and Budget
series.description: Covers positions focused on accounting, budget administration, financial management, and closely related support work.

series.name: Medical, Hospital, Dental, and Public Health
series.description: Covers positions focused on medicine, dentistry, public health, patient care, and related technical support.

series.name: Veterinary Medical Science
series.description: Covers positions focused on veterinary medicine, animal health, clinical services, and related technical support work.

series.name: Engineering and Architecture
series.description: Covers positions focused on engineering and architecture for projects, facilities, systems, structures, equipment, and materials.

series.name: Legal and Kindred
series.description: Covers positions focused on legal analysis, legal services, case support, and closely related functions.

series.name: Information and Arts
series.description: Covers positions focused on communications, public information, museums, cultural collections, and fine or applied arts.

series.name: Business and Industry
series.description: Covers positions focused on business, trade, industry, regulation, property management, and commercial advisory work.

series.name: Copyright, Patent, and Trademark
series.description: Covers positions focused on copyrights, patents, trademarks, and related scientific, technical, or legal work.

series.name: Physical Sciences
series.description: Covers positions focused on the physical sciences, scientific research, and related technical support work.

series.name: Library and Archives
series.description: Covers positions focused on library science, archives, records stewardship, and related technical support work.

series.name: Mathematical Sciences
series.description: Covers positions focused on mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, and other work grounded in mathematical methods.

series.name: Equipment, Facilities, and Services
series.description: Covers positions focused on operating, maintaining, or supporting government facilities, equipment, shops, and service operations.

series.name: Education
series.description: Covers positions focused on education, training, instruction, curriculum support, and related educational program administration.

series.name: Inspection, Investigation, Enforcement, and Compliance
series.description: Covers positions focused on inspection, investigation, enforcement, compliance, and related work involving laws or regulations.

series.name: Quality Assurance, Inspection, and Grading
series.description: Covers positions focused on quality assurance, inspection, process review, and commodity grading under official standards.

series.name: Supply
series.description: Covers positions focused on supply planning, acquisition, storage, distribution, utilization, and final disposal activities.

series.name: Transportation
series.description: Covers positions focused on transportation services, transportation regulation, logistics coordination, and government transportation programs.

series.name: Information Technology
series.description: Covers positions focused on planning, developing, delivering, securing, and supporting information technology systems and services.

series.name: Wire Communications Equipment Installation and Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in constructing, installing, maintaining, repairing, and testing wire communications systems and related equipment.

series.name: Electronic Equipment Installation and Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in installing, repairing, calibrating, modifying, and testing electronic equipment and integrated systems.

series.name: Electrical Installation and Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in fabricating, installing, altering, maintaining, repairing, and testing electrical systems and equipment.

series.name: Fabric and Leather Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in making, modifying, and repairing clothing, gear, and other items from fabric, leather, plastic, or similar materials.

series.name: Instrument Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in building, calibrating, installing, repairing, and maintaining instruments and instrumentation systems.

series.name: Machine Tool Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in operating machine tools and hand tools to make or repair metal parts, tools, and mechanisms.

series.name: General Services and Support Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in general labor, material handling, cleaning, and basic maintenance work that requires little specialized training.

series.name: Structural and Finishing Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in structural and finishing work for construction, maintenance, and repair of buildings and surfaces.

series.name: Metal Processing
series.description: Covers occupations involved in processing or treating metals to change their properties or produce desired qualities.

series.name: Metal Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in shaping metal and making or repairing metal parts and equipment.

series.name: Motion Picture, Radio, Television, and Sound Equipment Operation
series.description: Covers occupations involved in operating and making minor repairs to motion picture, radio, television, and sound equipment.

series.name: Lens and Crystal Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in making precision optical elements, crystal materials, and similar components through cutting, grinding, and polishing.

series.name: Painting and Paperhanging
series.description: Covers occupations involved in painting, decorating, finishing, and paperhanging for buildings, equipment, and furnishings.

series.name: Plumbing and Pipe-fitting
series.description: Covers occupations involved in installing, maintaining, and repairing pipelines, fixtures, and related plumbing systems.

series.name: Pliable Materials Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in shaping, forming, and repairing items made from pliable nonmetallic materials.

series.name: Printing Family
series.description: Covers occupations involved in printing production, from layout and plate making to presswork and finishing.

series.name: Wood Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in building, altering, repairing, and maintaining wooden structures and wood products.

series.name: General Maintenance and Operations Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in multi-trade maintenance, construction, repair, and operations work across buildings, grounds, utilities, or equipment.

series.name: General Equipment Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in maintaining or repairing equipment that does not fit another specialized maintenance family.

series.name: Plant and Animal Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in farming, groundskeeping, tree care, and the care or control of plants and animals.

series.name: Miscellaneous Occupations
series.description: Covers occupations that do not fit another established trade, craft, labor, or maintenance family.

series.name: Industrial Equipment Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in installing, maintaining, and repairing industrial machinery, production tools, and equipment.

series.name: Industrial Equipment Operation
series.description: Covers occupations involved in operating industrial equipment and utilities used to move materials or produce services.

series.name: Transportation/Mobile Equipment Operation
series.description: Covers occupations involved in operating transportation vehicles and other self-propelled mobile equipment, except aircraft.

series.name: Transportation/Mobile Equipment Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in repairing, adjusting, and maintaining transportation and other mobile equipment, except aircraft.

series.name: Ammunition, Explosives, and Toxic Materials Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in manufacturing, handling, testing, modifying, or disposing of ammunition, explosives, chemicals, and toxic materials.

series.name: Armament Work
series.description: Covers occupations involved in installing, repairing, rebuilding, adjusting, modifying, and testing small arms, artillery, and related accessories.

series.name: Packing and Processing
series.description: Covers occupations involved in protecting, preserving, packing, and processing materials and equipment for storage or transport.

series.name: Laundry, Dry Cleaning, and Pressing
series.description: Covers occupations involved in laundering, dry cleaning, pressing, dyeing, and preparing items for delivery.

series.name: Food Preparation and Serving
series.description: Covers occupations involved in preparing, cooking, portioning, and serving food in institutional or commercial settings.

series.name: Personal Services
series.description: Covers occupations involved in grooming, beauty, and other personal services, or caring for personal effects.

series.name: Fluid Systems Maintenance
series.description: Covers occupations involved in repairing, modifying, assembling, and testing fluid systems and components for aircraft, missiles, and support equipment.

series.name: Engine Overhaul
series.description: Covers occupations involved in manufacturing, repairing, modifying, and overhauling engines and their related systems.

series.name: Aircraft Overhaul
series.description: Covers occupations involved in overhauling aircraft, including major disassembly, reassembly, inspection, maintenance, and testing.

series.name: Film Processing
series.description: Covers occupations involved in processing film and preparing it for use or distribution. Excluded: work requiring specialized subject-matter knowledge or artistic ability.
